title: Shared djshellshoxxx.github.io origin: 35 sibling Pages sites can read/rewrite all GhostPay storage and script the app (High once payments are enabled; Medium for a demo)
evidence: scripts/pages/build-pages.sh:60-69,93-101@7a620ff1 (shared detection; manifests refused on shared origin unless GHOSTPAY_PAGES_ALLOW_SHARED_ORIGIN=testnet)
gh api -X GET search/repositories q='user:djshellshoxxx' (2026-11-18): 86 public repos, 36 has_pages=true incl. GhostPay; q='user:djshellshoxxx in:name github.io' -> 0 (no root user site)
apps/web/src/lib/settings.ts:5-29,137-148@7a620ff1 (plaintext RPC URLs, pinnedSigners); apps/web/locales/en.json:2037 ('pinned by you' label)
built Pages index.html banner warns about shared origin ($SP/out/E/pages-demo/site/index.html)
docs/pages/RELEASE_MATRIX.md:53 (project rated Confirmed medium, owner action open)
affected: seller keys later reused on mainnet (keystore chain-agnostic)
remediation: Serve from a repo-level custom domain (CNAME on the GhostPay repo, not an account-wide user-site domain) or a dedicated account/org; keep payments refused on shared origin; warn that keys ever loaded on a shared origin are testnet-only; do not create a root <owner>.github.io site (root-scoped service worker risk).
verification: Live: page origin == dedicated origin (see E-03); probe from a sibling path cannot read storage.
blocks: Sepolia beta on github.io (unless written owner acceptance)

title: Stale prototype (gh-pages cc8d0794, 2026-10-21) probably live on /GhostPay/: runtime unsigned manifest loading, no mirror banner, predates later fixes
evidence: git: refs/remotes/origin/gh-pages = cc8d0794 'Publish GhostPay build with help, why, privacy options and how-it-works pages' (2026-10-21)
docs/pages/README.md:173@7a620ff1 ('Source: GitHub Actions. The prototype's gh-pages branch is then unused' => currently in use)
gh-pages:assets/index-Bmfq019n.js function Xg: fetch ./deployments/<id>.json -> {status:'loaded'} with schema check only, no signature verification
live fetch blocked by sandbox proxy (403 CONNECT) => live state UNVERIFIED
remediation: Owner: Settings > Pages > Source = GitHub Actions (or unpublish); delete/archive gh-pages; then run scripts/pages/smoke.mjs against the live URL with --commit.

title: Shared-origin gate trusts the declared GHOSTPAY_PAGES_ORIGIN (*.github.io suffix only); deployed page_url origin never asserted; account-wide custom domains pass as dedicated
remediation: Assert new URL(page_url).origin === vars.GHOSTPAY_PAGES_ORIGIN in deploy/smoke; require repo-level cname + https_enforced from the Pages API; treat any origin that serves other project sites as shared.
verification: Workflow test: mismatched origin fails the run.

title: Deploy trust boundary not demonstrated: main reportedly unprotected; Pages artifact unsigned/unattested and not bound to the release trust root
evidence: .github/workflows/ghostpay-codex-cloud.yml:57@7a620ff1 ('main has NO branch protection or rulesets (checked 2026-11-04 ...)')
.github/workflows/ghostpay-codex-cloud.yml:21-28,35-52@7a620ff1 (contents:write + PAT; agent may change apps/*, packages/*)
ADR-0029: 'Branch protection and the github-pages environment rules are part of the security boundary'; gate 2 Open
affected: all code served to Pages users
remediation: Rulesets on main (required reviews + checks, no force push); github-pages env main-only + required reviewers; actions/attest-build-provenance on Pages SHA256SUMS; publish signed checksums out of band; optionally require dispatch from a signed tag verified by verify-tag.sh.
verification: Owner provides rulesets/env API output; gh attestation verify on served files.

title: 'Local proxy' scan transport is unusable: Settings accepts http loopback endpoints but CSP connect-src blocks them in every shipped profile (fails closed)
evidence: Chromium probe on built Pages artifact: securitypolicyviolation 'connect-src http://127.0.0.1:47126/', proxyHits 0 ($SP/out/E/logs/csp_loopback_probe.json)
remediation: Add http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* http://[::1]:* to connect-src (meta, _headers, nginx) or require https loopback (mkcert) and say so; add Playwright test under the real meta CSP; fix docs.
verification: e2e: scan through a local JSON-RPC forwarder succeeds and no direct RPC is contacted.

title: wss:// RPC URLs are accepted and allowed by CSP but no transport supports them (always fail closed)
remediation: Reject wss in checkRpcUrl or implement a WebSocket transport; drop wss: from connect-src if unused; fix copy.

title: Default chain-adapters fetchTransport omits credentials:'omit', cache:'no-store', referrerPolicy:'no-referrer' (other transports set them)
affected: all Settings-RPC traffic (pay, scan, sweep, registry)
remediation: Set the three options in fetchTransport; extend privacy invariants to packages/chain-adapters and net-transport.
